description: Privileged bridge into Thunderbird's internal XMPP implementation, used to hook outgoing/incoming message stanzas for OMEMO encryption. See docs/PLAN.md for why this needs an Experiment rather than a stable WebExtension API.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Monkey-patches XMPPConversationPrototype.dispatchMessage and GenericAccountPrototype's XMPP onMessageStanza to route plaintext through the OMEMO layer. Idempotent; safe to call multiple times.

functions.name: uninstall
functions.description: Restores the original, unpatched functions. Used on add-on disable/uninstall.

functions.name: setSettings
functions.description: Applies the options page's encryption setting: mode is manual (off unless switched on per chat), available (always use OMEMO when available) or always (always use OMEMO).

functions.name: getOwnDevices
functions.description: This Thunderbird's OMEMO device on each connected XMPP account, with its fingerprint and the xmpp: link Conversations-family apps scan to verify it.

functions.name: addFeatures
functions.description: Generic hook: adds service discovery features to our disco#info and caps hash (for example Jingle's, for calls). Best called before install(), so the first presence carries them.

functions.name: addHintCommand
functions.description: Adds a command to XMPP one-to-one chats that only shows a message in the chat (the free add-on's /call, pointing to the Pro version). Removed when the add-on shuts down.

functions.name: watchStanzas
functions.description: Generic hook: IQ gets/sets with a child in one of the iq namespaces, and messages with a child (or a carbon-forwarded message with a child) in one of the message namespaces, go to onStanza instead of Thunderbird. Replaces any earlier watch. The add-on answers watched IQs itself with sendStanza.

functions.name: getAccounts
functions.description: Generic hook: the connected XMPP accounts, as { jid (bare), fullJid }.

functions.name: chatNames
functions.description: Names for chat contacts from the address book (src/contacts/): matches each connected XMPP account's chat contacts against the cards (vCard texts) and, with apply, writes the names where each account's mode says (off; local, Thunderbird only; server, also the roster). Returns { cards, accounts: [{ jid, mode, contacts }], written }, or null when it failed (see the [omemo] ERROR line).

functions.name: chatGroups
functions.description: A group per account in Thunderbird's chat contact list, in Thunderbird only (src/contacts/chat-groups.js): moves each connected account's chat contacts into groups[jid], or out of applied[jid] when it has none. Returns { accounts: [{ jid, group, contacts, moved }], applied }, or null when it failed.

functions.name: chatSections
functions.description: A section per account in Thunderbird's chat contact list, in Thunderbird only (src/contacts/chat-sections.js): on shows one section per account, named names[jid] or the part of the account's address before the @, in place of Online contacts and Offline contacts; off puts Thunderbird's list back. Returns whether the sections show.

functions.name: sendStanza
functions.description: Generic hook: sends a stanza, given as XML text, from the connected account with this bare JID.

functions.name: sendIq
functions.description: Generic hook: sends an IQ, given as XML text, from the connected account with this bare JID, and resolves with the reply (result or error) as XML text. Rejects when no reply comes in time.

events.name: onStanza
events.description: Generic hook: a stanza matching watchStanzas, as { account (bare JID), kind (iq or message), xml }.

events.name: onDiagnostic
events.description: Debug only (task 4.0): every [omemo] diagnostic line the Experiment logs, so it also shows in the add-on's own console. Lines from before the listener was added are replayed.

events.name: onOutgoingPlaintext
events.description: Debug only (task 4.0): fires with (conversationId, plaintext) whenever the dispatchMessage hook runs. Task 3.0 moves encryption into the Experiment, after which this goes away.

events.name: onIncomingEncrypted
events.description: Debug only (task 4.0): fires with (from, encryptedPayload) when an incoming stanza has an <encrypted> element in the oldmemo/twomemo namespace. encryptedPayload is { namespace, xml }. Task 3.0 moves decryption into the Experiment, after which this goes away.

events.name: onShowPage
events.description: Fired by /omemo qr and /omemo help: open the add-on's page at a section.

events.name: onChatContactsChanged
events.description: A chat contact landed in a group in Thunderbird's contact list (Thunderbird's contact-tag-added), so the per-account groups may need putting right.

events.name: onAccountConnected
events.description: An XMPP account finished connecting (its roster has arrived), with its bare JID.
